revisions.goal: Fix broken repository-relative Playwright screenshot artifacts and render log artifacts as text evidence instead of image placeholders.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: Repository-relative image artifacts resolve through a safe EVE API URL and render in thumbnails/modals; .eve artifact paths continue to work; log artifacts use a compact monospace text preview and text viewer with useful fallback states; generic non-image artifacts no longer show a broken-image-style placeholder; targeted UI and Go regression tests, UI build, and relevant repository tests pass.

milestones.title: Regression coverage
milestones.goal: Add deterministic tests for repository-relative artifact URLs, route safety, and log classification.

milestones.title: Artifact rendering
milestones.goal: Serve safe repository-relative artifacts and add type-appropriate log/file cards and previews.

milestones.title: Verification
milestones.goal: Run targeted tests, build the UI, and visually verify screenshot and log behavior.
